evals.prompt: Set up a memory bank for this project so future sessions know how it works.
evals.expected_output: memory-bank/ created via memory.py init; context files populated through a validated operations batch with facts verifiable in README.md, package.json, .env.example and middleware.ts; no secrets; active-context.md filled.
expectations: Ran scripts/memory.py init, then applied at least one operations batch (no hand edits to entry files)
tech-stack.md records Next.js 14.2, Clerk, Drizzle and Neon with versions and src attributes
Commands section includes pnpm dev and pnpm test
Env vars are recorded by name only

evals.prompt: I just spent an hour on this: the /api/share route kept returning 401 even when I was logged in. Turns out the middleware matcher was fine, but I was calling auth() from a helper in lib/ that ran outside the request scope. Moving the auth() call into the route handler fixed it. Remember this.
evals.expected_output: Record mode: runs find first; stores one lesson root (or delta under an existing auth root, with a specific when) and a trap describing the failed approach; updates active-context.md; reports IDs.
expectations: Created a trap whose content includes FAILED and INSTEAD
Did not create two entries that say the same thing
Reported recorded IDs to the user

evals.prompt: We switched from Drizzle to Prisma last week. Update the memory so it stops telling you to use drizzle-kit.
evals.expected_output: SUPERSEDE (not UPDATE) of the Drizzle tech-stack and decision entries with reasons; old entries appear in history/archive.md; harmful feedback or deletion for drizzle-specific experience entries.
expectations: Used SUPERSEDE for entries whose fact changed
history/archive.md contains the superseded Drizzle entries
No remaining active entry recommends drizzle-kit

evals.prompt: The memory bank feels bloated. Clean it up.
evals.expected_output: Maintain mode: runs validate and consolidate; promotes proven deltas with self-contained content; prunes harmful entries; merges duplicates; applies one batch; summarizes changes.
expectations: Ran memory.py consolidate before changing anything
Any PROMOTE content is self-contained (no references to 'the above' or the parent)
Did not delete entries with helpful counts without a stated reason
